Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Here are three more questions I've considered:

1) So, what *is* a Black Spiral Buddy, anyway??

3) What led to the ruling that the Leather Jacket won't prevent the
damage from your *own* strikes? It's rather silly, on the common-sense
side of things, to say that the Jacket can stop a 3pt Grenade if you're
the recipient, but can't stop the 1 pt backwash if you're the attacker.
Or can stop one side of a Burst of Sunlight, but not the other. Was
this card somehow broken the other way??

3. My (Jyhad) copy of Outcast Mage shows a cost of 3 while the Deck
Monger and an earlier VEKN Tremere newsletter both list a cost of 2. I
can't find anything in the errata. What *is* the cost??

Thanks loads,
Madman

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 16 Mar 2000, Madman2001 wrote:
> 1) So, what *is* a Black Spiral Buddy, anyway??

In Werewolf: The Apocalypse, there are the good guys, who were all born in
the waxing moon - so they're good. However, you get people born in the
waning moon, and those who defect, who are the bad guys. They dance the
Black Spiral. In Jyhad, you make friends with one. A buddy. Hence, a
black spiral buddy.

Essentially, nasty bad guy werewolf.

>
> 3) What led to the ruling that the Leather Jacket won't prevent the
> damage from your *own* strikes?

A generic ruling which said "damage from a strike only applies to damage
dealt by the opposing minion".

> It's rather silly, on the common-sense
> side of things, to say that the Jacket can stop a 3pt Grenade if you're
> the recipient, but can't stop the 1 pt backwash if you're the attacker.
> Or can stop one side of a Burst of Sunlight, but not the other. Was
> this card somehow broken the other way??

Broken, probably not. Powerful, yes. Consider Bomb, for a start, or an
inferior Burst of Sunlight. The generic ruling scuppers cards with
serious downsides that werent' supposed to be got round with 1 blood and
Skin of Steel.

> 3. My (Jyhad) copy of Outcast Mage shows a cost of 3 while the Deck
> Monger and an earlier VEKN Tremere newsletter both list a cost of 2. I
> can't find anything in the errata. What *is* the cost??

My cards are elsewhere. However, my gut reaction is that it is 3, but
that probbaly the others are using the Wizards card text file (or
similar) which may well be wrong.

--

James Coupe

Messages.Author: Tammy, Chris, and Alex Shorb
Messages.Body:
Frederick Scott wrote:

[snip]

>
> Are you sure you're not thinking of _Nephandus_ mage - a card that looks
> suspciously like they wanted to design a Sabbat version of Outcast Mage
> for Tremere Antis? Arguably weaker than Outcast Mage (its abilities are
> slightly different) but for an ally it's a surprisingly worthwhile card
> at its cost of 2.
>
> Fred

Are you freaking kidding me?! Nephandus is perhaps the best/most
undercosted ally there is. And she is not unique! Let's see - 1
bleed, 1R, optional press, can diablerize for free (it's called
something else, but is essentially the same), 2 life. *And she's not
unique!!*. Compare to the political Ally, same cost, but unique, 3
bleed, 0 damage, and only 1 life. Perhaps the only thing working
against her (Nephandus) is that she is a member of a pretty thin
clan. But throw a couple of her out there, scatter Memories of
Mortality liberally, and you have a very interesting situation! Not
broken, but compared to other allies, undercosted (just like Ian
Forestal, another Tremere! card).

Chris
